verdict.rationale: Copilot docs list cloud agent access as a plan feature and say agent apps are powered by your Copilot subscription, so the subscription does grant use of the coding agents. The evidence does not describe signing in with an existing plan to use the agent in the IDE, CLI or cloud. Missing for 10: documented sign-in/authentication flow tied to the subscription plan, per-plan agent entitlement details, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: Access to Cloud agent and code review
Agent apps let you use partner-built agents directly in your workflows on GitHub, powered by your Copilot subscription.
With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
